main_result: For N=2, b=0, diagonal A, Bell-diagonal PPT/separability is equivalent to max_s p_s<=1/2 (equivalently sum_i |c_i|<=1); an identical-site tau tensor tau mixture exists exactly when c_i>=0 for all i. An exact M=2 witness has Bell probabilities (8,8,16,1)/33 and is separable but not an identical-site mixture.
validation: Python 3 standard-library Fraction script executed; exact matrix equality, trace, Bell probabilities, rational parameter ratios, PPT eigenvalues, and negative-correlation obstruction all pass.
scope_limits: Exact finite N=2, b=0, diagonal-A classification and witness only.
The witness is separable, so it does not refute mixtures of arbitrary product states; it refutes only the identical-site product-mixture interface.
No inference to large-N asymptotic approximation, decoder performance, finite-bit sampler, operational cost, or priority.
